title: iPhone free for 5 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
The iPhone has had no holder for 5 min (since 11:17Z; released by fix-morph-gpu). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: hero-exit-threaded (owner fix-hero-exit-threaded; its note names the phone).
Owners: take it now (node tools/lock.mjs acquire iphone --owner <you> ...), or say here why not.
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the slot is taken (tools/idle.mjs, I-105).

The iPhone is idle on purpose: all phone work is paused until the 12:20Z usage reset. hero-exit-threaded is parked on that pause, not waiting for the phone. Phone work resumes after 12:20Z in this order: countdown roll check, countdown display-rate check, scroll-handler no-worse check.

What you need to do: nothing.
